repo.name: OpenMontage
repo.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skills. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

analysis.oneLiner: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skills. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.；关键看工具边界、上下文持久化、权限和失败接管是否可治理。
analysis.whyItMatters: calesthio/OpenMontage 值得看，是因为 AI 项目真正的分水岭已经从“能跑 demo”转向“能被治理、能接工具、能失败恢复”。当前 13.3K stars / 1.6K forks，维护非常活跃，足够进入 Agent 工程雷达。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：模型接口、工具协议、上下文管理或推理工作流 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。
analysis.engineeringRead: Python · Node 包/前端工程。建议按“入口示例 -> 数据/配置 -> 失败处理 -> CI/release -> issue 反例”的顺序读；重点回答 它解决的是「AI 应用编排、工具接入或模型调用复杂度」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？

适用团队：已有标准化人工流程、权限边界和审计需求的 Agent/自动化平台团队。

观察信号：任务完成率、人工接管率、单次任务成本、最近 release 质量、issue 响应速度和 Node 包/前端工程 的集成反馈。

适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: Meta 要解决的是 UGC 推荐候选池越来越大、召回和排序目标割裂的问题：召回吞吐必须提升，但不能牺牲后续 ranker 真正关心的兴趣匹配和新鲜度。
interpretation.systemMechanism: SilverTorch 把索引视为可训练模型，把 embedding、ANN/检索、GPU serving 和 ranker 表征放到同一优化框架里，用 index-as-model 缩短召回与排序之间的语义距离。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 验证重点不是单看 recall@K，而是候选吞吐、GPU 成本效率、P95 检索延迟、ranker 入口质量、线上 CTR/停留和长尾内容覆盖的联合变化。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴的是“召回也要模型化治理”：把索引刷新、召回预算、重排目标和在线指标放进同一实验表，而不是让检索团队只交付一个向量库。
interpretation.boundary: 如果候选规模还不大、内容更新慢或没有召回/排序联合 owner，直接复制 index-as-model 会带来额外训练、索引和 GPU 运维负担。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 与 Google Cloud 将企业 RAG 改造成多 Agent 检索工作流，用 sufficient context agent 反复补齐证据后再回答，面向跨语料、多跳企业搜索。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业 RAG 最大痛点是回答看似流畅但证据不够、跨库查询漏召、权限语境错配，最终让业务方无法把它接到客服、运营或内部知识搜索。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Google 的 Agentic RAG 思路是让检索流程变成多步代理：先判断上下文是否充分，再补充检索、重排和证据校验，最后才生成答案。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 应同时看 answer correctness、sufficient-context 命中率、NDCG/MRR、权限误召、二次查询率、人工接管率和端到端延迟。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴到企业搜索/RAG：在生成前增加“证据是否足够”的可观测节点，并把失败样本回流到查询改写、检索器和评测集。
interpretation.boundary: 知识库权限混乱、文档元数据缺失或无法保存证据链时，多 Agent 检索只会放大不可审计风险。

items.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
items.summary: Meta 讨论在实时广告推荐中服务 LLM-scale 排序模型的复杂度/效率矛盾，核心是让模型容量、延迟预算和广告业务目标共同优化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告排序希望引入更大模型捕捉用户与广告主价值，但实时竞价链路受延迟、预算消耗和单位请求成本约束，不能把所有候选都交给重模型。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Meta 的 Adaptive Ranking Model 重点在“按候选价值分配推理容量”：让模型规模、特征丰富度和服务路径随请求难度变化，而不是静态套一层大模型。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 实验要并看 CTR、CVR、ROAS/CPA、广告质量、用户负反馈、P95/P99 延迟、单次请求 GPU 成本和预算平滑消耗。
interpretation.borrowable: 对广告/推荐团队的启发是把模型容量做成排序策略的一部分：先识别高不确定、高价值候选，再动态使用更重的表征或重排。
interpretation.boundary: 转化回传慢、广告主价值归因不稳或没有成本看板时，自适应重模型很难证明净收益。

items.title: From Clicks to Conversions: Architecting Shopping Conversion Candidate Generation at Pinterest

interpretation.businessProblem: Pinterest 购物广告不能只优化点击，真正业务目标是转化；但转化样本稀疏、延迟回传明显，候选生成阶段很容易把“会点”的广告误当成“会买”的广告。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 候选生成模型从点击序列扩展到购物转化信号，把用户行为、广告/商品属性和转化目标前移到召回阶段，减少后续 ranker 的无效候选压力。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点观察 CVR、ROAS、候选覆盖率、召回阶段转化命中率、下游 ranker 负载、冷启动商品覆盖和线上长期留存。
interpretation.borrowable: 电商/本地生活广告可以借鉴“转化目标前移”：召回阶段就区分点击兴趣与购买意图，并建立延迟转化回传的训练样本治理。

items.title: Enhancing Ad Relevance: Integrating Real-Time Context into Sequential Recommender Models
items.summary: Pinterest 将实时上下文接入序列推荐模型，报告转化相关 ROAS 指标提升，适合观察广告实时特征和在线实验闭环。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告序列模型常用历史行为，但用户会话意图变化快；不接实时上下文时，模型容易把昨天的兴趣用于当前请求，影响广告相关性和 ROAS。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/SproutRAG.

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: Meta 要解决的是 UGC 推荐候选池越来越大、召回和排序目标割裂的问题：召回吞吐必须提升，但不能牺牲后续 ranker 真正关心的兴趣匹配和新鲜度。
interpretation.systemMechanism: SilverTorch 把索引视为可训练模型，把 embedding、ANN/检索、GPU serving 和 ranker 表征放到同一优化框架里，用 index-as-model 缩短召回与排序之间的语义距离。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 验证重点不是单看 recall@K，而是候选吞吐、GPU 成本效率、P95 检索延迟、ranker 入口质量、线上 CTR/停留和长尾内容覆盖的联合变化。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴的是“召回也要模型化治理”：把索引刷新、召回预算、重排目标和在线指标放进同一实验表，而不是让检索团队只交付一个向量库。
interpretation.boundary: 如果候选规模还不大、内容更新慢或没有召回/排序联合 owner，直接复制 index-as-model 会带来额外训练、索引和 GPU 运维负担。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 与 Google Cloud 将企业 RAG 改造成多 Agent 检索工作流，用 sufficient context agent 反复补齐证据后再回答，面向跨语料、多跳企业搜索。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业 RAG 最大痛点是回答看似流畅但证据不够、跨库查询漏召、权限语境错配，最终让业务方无法把它接到客服、运营或内部知识搜索。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Google 的 Agentic RAG 思路是让检索流程变成多步代理：先判断上下文是否充分，再补充检索、重排和证据校验，最后才生成答案。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 应同时看 answer correctness、sufficient-context 命中率、NDCG/MRR、权限误召、二次查询率、人工接管率和端到端延迟。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴到企业搜索/RAG：在生成前增加“证据是否足够”的可观测节点，并把失败样本回流到查询改写、检索器和评测集。
interpretation.boundary: 知识库权限混乱、文档元数据缺失或无法保存证据链时，多 Agent 检索只会放大不可审计风险。

items.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
items.summary: Meta 讨论在实时广告推荐中服务 LLM-scale 排序模型的复杂度/效率矛盾，核心是让模型容量、延迟预算和广告业务目标共同优化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告排序希望引入更大模型捕捉用户与广告主价值，但实时竞价链路受延迟、预算消耗和单位请求成本约束，不能把所有候选都交给重模型。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Meta 的 Adaptive Ranking Model 重点在“按候选价值分配推理容量”：让模型规模、特征丰富度和服务路径随请求难度变化，而不是静态套一层大模型。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 实验要并看 CTR、CVR、ROAS/CPA、广告质量、用户负反馈、P95/P99 延迟、单次请求 GPU 成本和预算平滑消耗。
interpretation.borrowable: 对广告/推荐团队的启发是把模型容量做成排序策略的一部分：先识别高不确定、高价值候选，再动态使用更重的表征或重排。
interpretation.boundary: 转化回传慢、广告主价值归因不稳或没有成本看板时，自适应重模型很难证明净收益。

items.title: From Clicks to Conversions: Architecting Shopping Conversion Candidate Generation at Pinterest
items.summary: Pinterest 介绍购物转化候选生成模型，从点击信号转向转化目标，并讨论大规模上线到 6 亿月活用户的系统设计。

interpretation.businessProblem: Pinterest 购物广告不能只优化点击，真正业务目标是转化；但转化样本稀疏、延迟回传明显，候选生成阶段很容易把“会点”的广告误当成“会买”的广告。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 候选生成模型从点击序列扩展到购物转化信号，把用户行为、广告/商品属性和转化目标前移到召回阶段，减少后续 ranker 的无效候选压力。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点观察 CVR、ROAS、候选覆盖率、召回阶段转化命中率、下游 ranker 负载、冷启动商品覆盖和线上长期留存。
interpretation.borrowable: 电商/本地生活广告可以借鉴“转化目标前移”：召回阶段就区分点击兴趣与购买意图，并建立延迟转化回传的训练样本治理。
interpretation.boundary: 如果业务转化链路不可追踪、广告主回传质量差或样本规模不足，转化候选生成会比点击召回更脆弱。

interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴实时特征分层：高价值会话信号进在线排序，低价值长尾特征保留在离线序列，避免全量实时化。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/SproutRAG.
